scope: S08 P4 flow: branches, stable aliases, predicates, assertion diagnostics, loops, switch exhaustiveness and evolving arrays

files./case.ts:
function branch(x:string|number) { if(typeof x === "string") return x; return 0; }
type Query_branch = typeof branch;

type Choice = {tag:"left"; left:string} | {tag:"right"; right:number}; function selection(x:Choice) { if(x.tag === "left") return x.left; return x.right; }
type Query_selection = typeof selection;

function aliases(x:string|number) { const isText = typeof x === "string"; if(isText) return x; return "fallback"; }
type Query_aliases = typeof aliases;

function isText(x:unknown): x is string { return typeof x === "string"; } function predicate(x:string|number) { if(isText(x)) return x; return "fallback"; }
type Query_predicate = typeof predicate;

function assertText(x:unknown): asserts x is string { if(typeof x !== "string") throw 0; } function assertion(x:unknown) { assertText(x); return x; }
type Query_assertion = typeof assertion;

function assertTruthy(x:unknown): asserts x { if(!x) throw 0; } function assertionCondition(x:string|undefined) { assertTruthy(x); return x; }
type Query_assertionCondition = typeof assertionCondition;

const assertBad = (x:unknown): asserts x is string => {}; function assertionTarget(x:unknown) { assertBad(x); return x; }
type Query_assertionTarget = typeof assertionTarget;

function loop(x:string|number, flag:boolean) { while(flag) { if(typeof x === "string") x = 1; else x = "value"; } return x; }
type Query_loop = typeof loop;

function exhaustive(x:"a"|"b") { switch(x) { case "a": return 1; case "b": return 2; } }
type Query_exhaustive = typeof exhaustive;

function typeSwitch(x:string|number|undefined) { switch(typeof x) { case "string": return x; case "number": return x; default: return false; } }
type Query_typeSwitch = typeof typeSwitch;

function trueSwitch(x:string|number|undefined) { switch(true) { case typeof x === "string": return x; case typeof x === "number": return x; default: return false; } }
type Query_trueSwitch = typeof trueSwitch;

type Presence = {left:string} | {right:number}; function presence(x:Presence) { if("left" in x) return x.left; return x.right; }
type Query_presence = typeof presence;

interface Array<T> { [n:number]: T; length:number; push(...items:T[]): number; unshift(...items:T[]):number; } function evolving(flag:boolean) { const values = []; values.push(1); if(flag) values.push("text"); return values; }
type Query_evolving = typeof evolving;

interface Array<T> { [n:number]: T; length:number; push(...items:T[]): number; unshift(...items:T[]):number; } function evolvingLoop(flag:boolean) { const values = []; while(flag) { values.push(1); values[0] = "text"; } return values; }
type Query_evolvingLoop = typeof evolvingLoop;
